newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-BOOKMAKERS TAKING NO CHANCES OVER DETTORI REPEAT.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-BOOKMAKERS TAKING NO CHANCES OVER DETTORI REPEAT.

text.p: Frankie Dettori has seven rides at Ascot on Saturday -- and bookmakers are taking no chances. Two weeks ago at the same track Dettori rode all seven winners in an historic 25,000-1 feat which cost the oddsmakers around 18 million pounds ($28.3 million).
At current forecast prices, the cumulative odds against another Dettori seven-timer on Saturday are just under 600,000-1.
But none of the big British firms is taking bets on a repeat. William Hill spokesman David Hood said: "I asked our odds-compiler to come up with a price but he said that would add insult to injury.
"He said it would be like asking a fellow who has had his house broken into what price it would be to happen again two weeks later!"
